fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for login and communication

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: User's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: User's last name

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

name: Task
description: Core task entity for personal task management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title or name of the task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the task

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Due date for task completion

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who owns this task

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the task was created

relationships.description: Each task belongs to one user

name: Notification
description: Stores notification messages and their display properties

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user receiving the notification

fields.name: message
fields.description: The notification message content

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (info, warning, error, success)

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

fields.name: relatedTaskId
fields.description: Optional reference to a related task
